subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 9
body:
Rev 9: the two /proc files IV needs after F18, plus their tests. 341 checks.

- /proc/self/maps: virtual, filled by the runner with `int n2vfs_set_maps(const char *text, uint32_t len)` (declared in n2vfs.c) after n2elf_link(). < 16384 bytes, NULL/0 clears, ENOENT until set, content snapshot at open. vpud-s remap_shmem() parse (first "rw-p"+"libvpud_vcodec.so" line, sscanf "%x-%x", copy that range into the VCU DMEM) is tested end to end through V30-s scanner with the nine-line list IV posted.
- /proc/device-tree/model = "MT6893\\n". drv_getchipname() exit(1)s without the file; with it, the chip id stays -1 ("get unknown chip name", its needle table has no 6893), same as the phone.

  N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
  N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
  N2TEST V33 PASS 341/341   (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1)

No host file access was reintroduced: maps/model are in the in-memory table. The not-done list is unchanged except that /proc/self/maps now exists when the runner supplies the loader map list (it is ENOENT otherwise, by design). IV has the API and is re-running the vpud boot.
